headline: HILLS Properties ranked in top 100 privately held companies in Greater Cincinnati; strong brand recognition and operational standing support expansion case

signals.summary: HILLS Properties named among top 100 privately owned companies in Greater Cincinnati, signaling strong regional brand, operational excellence, and market standing. This recognition reinforces their commitment to quality and positions them as a high-performing operator in their key market.
signals.suggestedAction: Congratulate Sara Perry and Sara Hendricks on the recognition; position this as proof point for a case study or customer testimonial highlighting how Reputation Management has driven their review performance (4.5 rating, 90% response rate, 595+ five-star reviews). Use this momentum to introduce cross-sell opportunities—especially Training and Policies to operationalize the brand excellence across all 6,800 units and 210 employees, and Mystery Shopping to protect the reputation gains already made.
